name: Magic Quiz
detailed_description:
ABOUT THIS GAME.

Magic Quiz is a fast-paced, competitive multiplayer quiz game for 2–6 players. But this isn’t your average trivia night. Knowledge alone isn’t enough here—you’ll need strategy, cunning, and a pinch of chaos magic to outwit your opponents.

Don't know the answer? No problem!. If you're clever with your skills, you can steal the win—literally. Outplay your opponents, protect your lead, or drag others down with you. Victory isn’t always fair, and that’s the fun.

Use powerful skills to increase your points, sabotage other players' answers, or even reverse their scores! The twist? Everyone sees what everyone else is doing… so trust no one, and answer fast.

NOT A REGULAR QUIZ

Answer with text, not guesses. No multiple choice—type the answer and watch the chaos unfold.

Strategic Skills: Disrupt others or empower yourself with game-changing abilities like:
See What Others Answer: Analyse rival answers in real-time and use that against them.

Points Matter, Timing Matters More: The faster you answer correctly, the more points you get.

Custom Lobbies: Host sessions, vote on categories, and toggle cooldowns for chaotic custom gameplay.

Free-to-Play: No upfront cost, just good vibes and even better rivalries.

Cosmetics & Question Packs: Unlock new looks and quiz sets with optional purchases.

EASY TO PLAY

  • Read the question.

  • Type your answer and use skills before time runs out.

  • See how your friends tried to sabotage you.

  • Laugh or rage at the results.

  • Repeat—with more tricks up your sleeve.

JOIN THE QUIZ REVOLUTION

Think you can outsmart your friends and the chaos? Wishlist now and prepare for the ultimate battle of brains and betrayal.
